strategic_constraints.timeline: Hackathon — demo must run end-to-end on synthetic data within the evaluation window

scope_note: Hackathon MVP. Synthetic data only, no real PII. All intelligence (cert parsing, matching/ranking, catalog de-dupe/tag/enrich/recommend) MUST go through the Claude API — no hardcoded/regex substitutes. Fake auth via role view-switcher (no real auth). Target: ~20-25 synthetic profiles. Protect the hero loop: cert upload -> profile updates -> re-run match improves.
